integrity: Analytical argument with separately reproducible numerical spot-checks; numerical checks are not infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Independent identically initialized one-dimensional Brownian searchers only.
Finite derivative for ranks k<=N-4; no conclusion on later ranks or globally optimal reset rate.
The continuous critical rank is an asymptotic interpolation, not a physical fractional-order statistic.
Unindexed or unpublished parallel calculations may affect publication priority.
title: Exact rank–population threshold ordering and finite-size shift for Brownian resetting
